ARCANE COMBAT GUIDE

Move & steerLeft joystick or WASD / arrow keys.
Aim & attackHold and drag an action, then release. Space sword · E spell.
Dash & leapShift grants brief invulnerability and clears low obstacles.
Arcane artQ unleashes your champion’s signature ability.
Map & pauseM expands the map · Esc pauses the battle.
SurviveStay inside the safe zone. Gather gold, gems, health, and mana.
